description: Ready-to-use notification payloads for testing the notifications service
note: Replace UUIDs with actual employee and supervisor IDs from your database

payloads.name: Borrow Request → Supervisor
payloads.description: Notification sent to supervisor when an employee submits a borrow request

payload.title: New Device Borrow Request
payload.message: Employee John Doe (ID: EMP-001) has requested to borrow MacBook Pro 16" (Asset: DEV-019). Expected return date: 2024-12-31. Purpose: Project development work.

payloads.name: Approval Notification → Employee
payloads.description: Notification sent to employee when supervisor approves their borrow request

payload.title: Borrow Request Approved
payload.message: Your request to borrow MacBook Pro 16" (Asset: DEV-019) has been approved by Supervisor Jane Smith. Please collect the device from the IT department. You can scan the device QR code to complete pickup.

payloads.name: Rejection Notification → Employee (with reason)
payloads.description: Notification sent to employee when supervisor rejects their borrow request

payload.title: Borrow Request Rejected
payload.message: Your request to borrow MacBook Pro 16" (Asset: DEV-019) has been rejected by Supervisor Jane Smith. Reason: Device is currently unavailable due to maintenance. Please submit a new request when the device becomes available.

payloads.name: Rejection Notification → Employee (confidential reason)
payloads.description: Notification sent to employee when supervisor rejects with sensitive reason

payload.title: Borrow Request Rejected
payload.message: Your request to borrow MacBook Pro 16" (Asset: DEV-019) has been rejected. Please contact your supervisor for more details.

usage_example.description: How to use these payloads with the notification service

employee_id.description: Must be a valid UUID of an employee in the employees table

title.description: Short, descriptive title for the notification

notification_type.description: Must be one of the enum values from notification_type_enum

published_by.description: UUID of employee who triggered the notification (can be null)

is_confidential.description: Mark sensitive notifications that require special handling
